response.original_title: Gísli Gunnarsson - Úr Öskunni - Live in Grindavík
response.overview: Gísli Gunnarsson performs his album Úr Öskunni live in the church of Grindavík, the town that had been left largely abandoned following the volcanic eruptions and the evacuation of its residents. A selected number of visitors attended the event, which was created first and foremost as an opportunity for the people of Grindavík - many of whom had been scattered across different communities since the evacuation - to come together in their hometown once again.
response.title: Gísli Gunnarsson - Úr Öskunni - Live in Grindavík
